bodyHtml:
What This Is

Proprietary GPT models designed by banks from the 'outside-in', following customers across channels and third-party AI platforms to deliver fluid, contextual banking interactions..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Banks designing proprietary GPTs from 'outside-in', understanding customer intent in real time, following them across channels and third-party AI platforms. Accenture Banking Trends 2026.
